title: [AUG-187] Ghost Mode: free X/Y drag with magnetic edges, caption width resize and a saved position
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 4, @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md): the ghost overlay moves only up/down (Ghost Caption pins X at @electron/src/compact.ts:231 and snaps to Top/Bottom; Ghost Coin snaps to a corner) and forgets its place on every launch (captionEdge / coinCorner are in-memory fields, compact.ts:106-108). He wants to put the overlay anywhere on the screen, left or right, and have August remember it. Decided in research AUG-176 (2026-11-03): option A magnetic edges, caption width resize in the same task, position stored in <userData>/window-state.json. Mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-176/ghost-mode.html (option A is the default view). Stop Meeting protection is already done (AUG-182) and is out of scope.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Ghost Caption and Ghost Coin drag freely on X and Y: `ghostDrag('move')` applies both dx and dy with no clamp while moving, so the window can be dragged onto another display (compact.ts:217-237).
- [ ] Release rule A (magnetic edges): on `ghostDrag('end')` the display is `screen.getDisplayMatching(bounds)`; an edge within 32 DIP of a work-area edge snaps flush with the existing margin (24 px caption, 16 px coin), two near edges give a corner, otherwise the window keeps its position; the final rect is always fully inside that work area and is re-applied with `setBounds` including width/height (DPI drift repair).
- [ ] Caption height resize keeps working at any position: the handle sits on the edge facing the display center (GhostApp.tsx:52-55 logic kept), the main process derives the fixed edge at resize start from the window center vs the work-area center (not from the last snap), max height = distance from the fixed edge to the work-area edge − 24.
- [ ] Caption width resize: 6 px handles on the left and right edges of the Ghost Caption, range 320–760 px, the opposite edge fixed, clamped to the work area; new pref `compactCaptionWidth` (default 760 when the work area allows; client default + type, server ALLOWED_KEYS + clamp 320–760 in sanitizeCompactPreferences, `caption-width` compact-event handled in CompactLayer like `caption-height`); `ghostBounds` uses it instead of min(760, 80 % wa) when set.
- [ ] Tools never clipped at small sizes (Rodion, 2026-11-03): today the five caption tools ([ ⤢ ] [ ⏸ ] [ mic ] [ TXT ] [ ■ ]) are a 3-column grid in the 104 px left zone (`.ghost-caption-tools--grid`, App.css), so at low heights the second row is cut off and End Meeting / Stop Live Text are unreachable. Rule: the rectangular tools stay exactly as today for as long as two rows of them fit in the left zone; only when the caption height drops below what the rectangles need do the tools switch to one row of five small squares (brackets dropped, same glyphs, same hold-to-stop on TXT and ■, 0 radius, tooltips keep the names); growing back past that height restores the rectangles. Both thresholds are measured from the rendered layout (ResizeObserver / measured height of the tools block), not hard-coded pixel numbers. The caption's minimum height and width are whatever the square row needs, and `ghostCaptionResize` / the width resize never shrink the window past that point (raise CAPTION_MIN_H and the server clamp in sanitizeCompactPreferences if 72 is below it). All five tools are fully visible and clickable at the minimum size. Reference behavior: the mockup caption (shrink it: rectangles down to ~92 px, squares below, floor at 72).
- [ ] Coin hover expansion grows toward the display center from the face (face never moves); if 372 px does not fit on that side the expansion flips; `anchoredRight` in GhostApp.tsx:251-253 still matches the expansion side.
- [ ] Saved position: `<userData>/window-state.json` gets an optional `ghost` object with one record per widget `{ displayId, hAnchor: 'left'|'right', hOffset, vAnchor: 'top'|'bottom', vOffset }` in DIP (offset = distance from the nearest work-area edge), written by the main process on drag end and resize end (@electron/src/windowState.ts read/write + validation; a malformed record is ignored, not fatal).
- [ ] Restore: `ensureGhost` resolves the display by `displayId` (fallback: the display of the main window's snapshot bounds), builds the rect from anchors + offsets + current size, clamps it into that work area; a missing or invalid record uses today's default (bottom center / bottom-right). Verified by relaunching the app and re-entering the ghost widget.
- [ ] Off-screen recovery: while a ghost exists, `screen` 'display-removed' and 'display-metrics-changed' re-run the clamp; Settings → Compact mode gets a "Reset overlay position" row (bridge method clears `ghost` in window-state.json and re-applies the default; optional bridge method in desktop.d.ts + preload.cts, ghost-only channels stay ghost-only).
- [ ] No diagnostics leak into the UI: no coordinates, display ids or offsets are shown in Settings or in the widgets (only the Reset row).
- [ ] Unit tests: pure helpers for the release rule (snap/clamp) and for the record build/restore (anchors ↔ rect, missing display, invalid record) in electron tests, mocking displays; existing `config.test.ts` / `gpuBackend.test.ts` still pass on both platform mocks.
- [ ] Verified on Windows: drag left/right/top/bottom, snap at 32 px, two-monitor drag and restore, relaunch restore, width and height resize, rectangles → squares switch and the minimum height floor; macOS run pending in a release build (note it in the card like AUG-181/182).
- [ ] Route READMEs updated: desktop-shell (Compact Mode section: free drag, release rule, window-state `ghost` record, width pref, square tools / minimum size) and preferences (compactCaptionWidth, any new minimum for compactCaptionHeight).
important_constraints:
Scope decided in AUG-176: A magnetic edges; width resize in scope; storage in window-state.json (NOT a preference). Keep compactCaptionHeight where it is. electron/src/main.ts and compact.ts are shared high-risk files: every `process.platform` branch (applyOnTop) stays as is; new behavior must be a no-op difference between Windows and macOS. Reuse the existing ghost IPC channels (august:ghost-drag / ghost-caption-resize); a width resize may add a phase payload or one new ghost-only channel accepted only from the ghost webContents. No Stop Meeting changes (done in AUG-182). Brandbook: 0 border-radius; width handles mirror the existing 6 px height handle. Mockup for look and behavior: @docs/mockups/AUG-176/ghost-mode.html. Roadmap: M2 Live session control, line "Ghost Mode free X/Y drag". Research card: AUG-176-j6c3bw.

Confirmed by the user on 2026-11-03 after trying the mockup: mouse only — do NOT implement the arrow-key nudge the mockup shows (8 / 32 DIP); the 32 DIP snap threshold feels right, keep it. Square tools: rectangles stay as long as two rows fit, squares only below that, floor = what the square row needs (see the acceptance criterion).

## Статус реализации (2026-11-03, commit 2db8c6c на master)
- Код готов по всем критериям; проверено: electron:compile, `npm run electron:test` 13/13, client tsc, server tsc, vitest config/gpuBackend/preferencesStore 101/101.
- Windows: пользователь проверил вручную в dev-сборке 2026-11-04 — «работает отлично». macOS — проверить в релизной сборке (как AUG-181/182).
- Грабли: первый ручной прогон шёл на старом main-процессе Electron (запущен до компиляции) с новым рендерером — resize молча игнорировался (старый main не понимал payload { phase, edge }). После изменений в electron/src нужен перезапуск Electron, HMR его не обновляет.
- Попутно найдено и исправлено (a667678): dev-сервер с gpuEngine=cuda не находил ffmpeg (искал только в win-x64-cuda) — не связано с AUG-187, проявилось после рестарта сервера.
- Известное ограничение: после drag коина рендерер выбирает сторону раскрытия по позиции до снапа — значимо только в ~32 px от центральной линии экрана.
- Решения: ширина через payload `{ phase, edge, minHeight }` на существующем august:ghost-caption-resize (без нового канала); сброс — `august:reset-ghost-position` только из main window; CAPTION_MIN_H остался 72 (ряд квадратов в него влезает), рендерер может только поднять пол через minHeight.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-04)
**Что сделано:**
- Ghost Caption и Ghost Coin свободно таскаются по X/Y, в т.ч. на другой монитор; на отпускании край ближе 32 DIP прилипает с отступом 24/16 px (два края — угол), иначе виджет остаётся где брошен, всегда целиком в рабочей области.
- Ширина Caption тянется за левый/правый край (320–760, pref compactCaptionWidth); высота работает в любой позиции, фиксированный край — по центру окна.
- Инструменты Caption при малой высоте переходят в один ряд квадратов (порог измеряется по вёрстке), ничего не обрезается.
- Coin раскрывается к центру экрана от неподвижного «лица», с переворотом если не влезает.
- Позиция каждого виджета запоминается между запусками; возврат на экран при отключении/смене монитора; Settings → Compact mode → «Reset overlay position».
**Как:** чистая геометрия в ghostGeometry.ts (снап, clamp, запись ↔ rect, выбор дисплея) с node:test; запись `ghost` в window-state.json (не преференс — это геометрия машины, как bounds окна; writeWindowState её сохраняет, битая запись отбрасывается); ширина — через payload на существующем канале, а не новый канал; сторону раскрытия коина считает рендерер и передаёт faceSide, чтобы направление ряда всегда совпадало. Отвергнуто: клавиатурный nudge (решение пользователя), хранение позиции в preferences.
**Файлы:** @electron/src/ghostGeometry.ts, @electron/src/ghostGeometry.test.ts, @electron/src/compact.ts, @electron/src/windowState.ts, @electron/src/main.ts, @electron/src/preload.cts, @client/src/components/compact/GhostApp.tsx, @client/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx, @client/src/App.css, @server/src/services/preferencesStore.ts, @server/src/routes/preferences.ts; миграций нет.
**PR / коммиты:** без PR, прямо в master: 2db8c6c (фича), a667678 (попутный фикс ffmpeg в dev с CUDA).
**Грабли:** ручной прогон на старом main-процессе Electron + новом рендерере — resize молча не работал; после правок electron/src обязателен перезапуск Electron. Сиротский tsx watch после закрытия August не может перезапустить сервер — dev-сервер пришлось поднимать заново.
**Хвосты:** проверка на macOS в релизной сборке; известное ограничение стороны раскрытия коина сразу после drag (~32 px от центра); узкий Caption (320 px) с панелью action items сжимает панель.
